description: Verify that a Unicast Find after >1/2 cyclic_offer_delay → DUT replies with multicast OfferService (SOME/IP-SD §4.2.1)
approach:
[Objective]
In Main Phase, if the time since the last cyclic OfferService is greater than half cyclic_offer_delay, DUT must answer the Unicast Find with a multicast OfferService — this synchronises all listeners on the same wire timing.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in Main Phase.
2. Wait > 1/2 × cyclic_offer_delay since last cyclic offer.
3. Tester → DUT (unicast): FindService.
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: OfferService with multicast dst_ip.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted offer is multicast (not unicast back to the requester).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_offer_not_multicast — DUT replied unicast
• Fail_no_offer_after_unicast_find — no OfferService at all

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied multicast to unicast Find — normal
verdicts.Fail_offer_not_multicast: Offer dst_ip not multicast after unicast Find
verdicts.Fail_no_offer_after_unicast_find: No offer within listen window after unicast Find
